field.label: Show Workflow Links on Entity Grids
field.comment: Renders a compact "N active for Orders · View · Create workflow" strip in the actions toolbar of the native admin grids (Orders, Customers, Products, Reviews, Invoices, Shipments, Credit Memos) so the workflow feature is discoverable where the entity lives. Disable to hide it everywhere; it is also hidden per-page for admins without the Workflows view permission.
